title: Generate product promo clips in Seedance 2.0 (expect ~5–10 minutes per clip)…
content: Generate product promo clips in Seedance 2.0 (expect ~5–10 minutes per clip) and cut them together with an avatar promoting the offer.
tips: Generate product promo clips in Seedance 2.0 (expect ~5–10 minutes per clip) and cut them together with an avatar promoting the offer.
